name: Butternut Squash Gratin

ingredients.name: butternut squash, peeled and thinly sliced

steps: Heat oven to 190°C. Peel and seed squash, then slice into even 3 mm pieces. Butter a shallow baking dish with 15 g butter.
Melt 10 g butter in a pan and cook onion 7 minutes until soft; stir in garlic and thyme for 1 minute. Whisk cream, milk, salt, pepper and nutmeg together.
Layer half the squash in the dish, overlapping slices. Scatter half the onion and one-third of the cheese over it; repeat with remaining squash and onion.
Pour cream mixture evenly over the layers. Cover tightly with foil and bake 30 minutes until a knife meets only slight resistance in the squash.
Mix breadcrumbs with remaining cheese and 10 g melted butter. Remove foil, scatter topping and bake 15–20 minutes until deeply golden and squash fully tender. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.
tips: Slice squash thinly and evenly so the centre cooks before the cheese browns; choose clearly labelled vegetarian cheese.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
